notes.title: Fix: Rewired Control Scheme Update (1/4/24)
notes.content: Minor update to rewired control scheme.

notes.title: Fix: Gun not firing when raycast miss (28/03/24)
notes.content: Fixed a case where the gun wouldn't fire when attempting to raycast while using a gamepad.

notes.title: HOTFIX: Actually added controller camera support (26/03/24)
notes.content: The controller mapping wasn't enabled on steam deck, so here is a hotfix to put it in place.

notes.title: WHNBSMF: Minor Control Fix + Camera
notes.content:
Minor control fix to make it "feel" better moving around.
Fixed the Camera so it's at a set position form the player. This will be rotatable in a future patch.

notes.title: WHNBSMF: New Year New Patch
notes.content: Updating the build to the current dev feature set.

notes.title: Fix: Text Layout Issue (30/08/23)
notes.content: Fixed a text layout issue on the news screen and z index issue with tutorial text.

notes.title: Fix: Minor Animation Issues(27/04/2023)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The players shooting animation now shows.
[*] The zombie walk animation is now more appropriate for a zombie.
[/list]

notes.title: Fix: Grenade Explosions (18/08/2023)
notes.content: Fixed grenade explosions so they now consistently trigger.

notes.title: Fix: Additional Spawn Issue (31/07/23)
notes.content: Fixed an additional spawn issue where the spawn prefab wasn't used in campaign maps, and only the Network Start Position was used. Now the game will fall back to use all Network Start Positions if they exist.

notes.title: Update Notes for 12/07/2023
notes.content: Add "Quit", "Restart Level" and "Back to Lobby" buttons to the mission failure screen
